actionId.description: The id of the activity this HITL request applies to: the ACP toolCallId for approvals, or the question id for questions. Identical to the activity's actionId.

message.description: The question or instruction shown to the user.

kind.description: The kind of HITL interaction: authorize a command (approval) or answer a structured question (question).

title.description: Short title of the action requesting approval (kind=approval).

toolKind.description: Tool kind of the action requesting approval, e.g. execute, edit (kind=approval).

options.description: Selectable options presented to the user (kind=approval).

diff.description: Before/after text of an edit-kind approval (kind=approval).

locations.description: File locations the action references (kind=approval). Used to build the activity row when the agent never announced a tool_call.

form.description: JSON Schema for the expected answer (kind=question).
